Label: Locomotion
Definition: Self-propelled horizontal displacement; distance, speed, stops.

Label: Rearing
Definition: Upright posture with forepaws off substrate; supported/unsupported.

Label: Digging
Definition: Vigorous displacement of substrate with forepaws; hind limbs spread.

Label: Sniffing
Definition: Nasal-oriented investigation; proximity threshold often applied.

Label: Exploratory behavior
Definition: Composite of locomotion, rearing, sniffing, head-dipping, digging, climbing.

Label: Approach
Definition: Movement reducing distance to a specified target.

Label: Avoidance
Definition: Movement increasing distance from a specified target.

Label: Orienting
Definition: Rapid head/body alignment toward a stimulus.
